content:
Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden cost: having to replace your case because the new iPhone is a different size than the old one.

For users upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, this seems likely to be the case — but two accessory manufacturers don't think so, and one of them is even betting big on it...

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo on Twitter of an Otterbox case that is already on sale at Best Buy, claiming the case is compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging reads in English and French:

For iPhone 18 Pro iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself is not entirely convinced, commenting "jumping the gun." However, Matt Ronge of Astropad — which makes anti-glare screen protectors for the iPhone — says their suppliers have told them the same thing.

Conflicting reports on iPhone Pro thickness

Last year, a leaker suggested that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. That report did not mention the smaller Pro model, but materials leaked from an iPhone supplier indicate that the iPhone 18 Pro will be two millimeters thicker than the previous generation.

This trend is consistent with previous years, as both iPhone 17 Pro models were thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

However, not all leakers agree with this claim — one of them says the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple sometimes provides dimensional information to a select group of long-standing case makers ahead of time so that third-party cases can launch alongside the new iPhone. On the other hand, sometimes accessory makers just guess at the dimensions based on rumors — and sometimes they guess wrong. Personally, I won't be pre-ordering any cases before the new iPhone is officially announced.
